mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals a weakening supply chain, which leads to reduced corporate output and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a single month signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals deflationary pressure, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL decreased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a single month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeds 3% in a quarter and unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals strong economic fundamentals, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 3% in a quarter AND UNRATE < 5%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeded 3% and UNRATE was below 5%.
